#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <chrono>

int main() {
    auto start = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();

    int n;
    std::string s;
    std::cin >> n >> s;

    bool inner = false;
    int len = 0;
    int maxOutside = 0;
    int insideWords = 0;

    for (size_t i = 0; i < s.length(); ++i) {
        char c = s[i];
        if (c == '_' || c == '(' || c == ')') {
            if (inner) {
                if (len > 0) insideWords++;
            } else {
                if (len > maxOutside) maxOutside = len;
            }
            if (c == '(') inner = true;
            else if (c == ')') inner = false;
            len = 0;
        } else {
            len++;
        }
    }

    if (inner) {
        if (len > 0) insideWords++;
    } else {
        if (len > maxOutside) maxOutside = len;
    }

    std::cout << maxOutside << " " << insideWords << std::endl;

    if (std::getenv("ONLINE_JUDGE") == nullptr) {
        auto end = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        auto ms = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start).count();
        std::cout << "[" << ms << "ms]" << std::endl;
    }

    return 0;
}
